title: What Retirement Health Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of retirement health: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Healthy retirement: 150 min/week of moderate activity, strength training 2x/week, sleep 7-9 hours, and staying socially connected. Health is the real retirement wealth.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Retirement Health
summary: Start retirement health this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Get a full physical + baseline labs
2. Build the exercise habit: walk + strength
3. Fix sleep (7-9 hrs, consistent schedule)
4. Schedule all preventive screenings
5. Plan health insurance to 65

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
